_comment: OpenCode CLI config. Both providers are registered in this single file. OpenCode reads 'provider.<id>.models.<model_id>' and you select which one to use via `opencode run --model <provider>:<model>`. Switch at runtime via `switch.bat` (which edits providers.json + reruns probe.py to regenerate opencode.json if needed).
_schema: OpenCode v0.x provider schema (npm @ai-sdk/openai-compatible for both).

_rules.models_in_provider: Each provider may have multiple models. Edit `models.<id>` to add a new model without changing the provider's connection details.
_rules.context_and_output: Must match providers.json (context=8192 / output=4096 for llamacpp; context=32768 / output=4096 for newapi). Drift causes OpenCode to silently truncate.
_rules.baseURL_format: MUST end with `/v1` (OpenCode strips path; missing /v1 = 404 on first chat)
_rules.apiKey: llamacpp accepts any non-empty string (no auth); newapi requires a real key from your internal NewAPI gateway.

_switcher._comment: How to switch between providers. Both work in the SAME opencode.json — you don't need to edit this file. switch.py handles it.
_switcher.auto_fallback: fallback.enabled=true in providers.json makes run.bat auto-pick the first online provider; manual override via switch.bat then run.bat
